gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)
scenario: Adult male Motion mode playing (continuous render), 6 s per preset after switching
caveats: A concurrent headless Blender job was running during measurement; 1% lows are affected
One machine only (Apple M4); no mid-range desktop or phone measured
Desktop numbers differ between runs (57/53/59 fps here vs ~42 fps in the independent dev-build run): treat them as indicative, not as a benchmark.

independent_check.conditions: same Apple M4, Chrome headless ANGLE Metal, DPR 2, Vite dev build (unminified), no concurrent Blender job
independent_check.finding: At 1440x900 the presets barely differ: the bottleneck is CPU-side (about 645 rig meshes = draw calls in Motion mode), not pixel count. Lowering the preset does not help that scene much; reducing draw calls would.

after_rig_merge.change: Motion-mode rig meshes merged per bone x material (~825 -> <200 draw groups)
after_rig_merge.conditions: Apple M4, Chrome headless ANGLE Metal, DPR 2, Vite dev build; another Chrome instance at ~100% CPU on the same machine
after_rig_merge.note: Values sit at the 60 fps vsync/headless cap, so the true headroom is not measured; the earlier independent dev-build baseline at 1440x900 was ~42 fps.
